description: Azur Bank - normalisation ECS des lignes pgaudit (PostgreSQL) vers logs-db.audit-*

script.description: Champs metier : event.action (select/insert/update/delete, export pour COPY ... TO), object (table sans schema)
script.source: String cmd = ctx._tmp.command.toLowerCase(); ctx.event = ctx.event ?: [:]; ctx.event.action = cmd == 'copy' ? 'export' : cmd; ctx.event.kind = 'event'; ctx.event.category = ['database']; ctx.event.type = ['access']; ctx.event.outcome = 'success'; String obj = ctx._tmp.object_name; if (obj != null && obj != '') { int i = obj.lastIndexOf('.'); String t = i >= 0 ? obj.substring(i + 1) : obj; ctx.object = t; ctx.db.table = t; ctx.db.object = obj; } ctx.db.audit = ['type': ctx._tmp.audit_type, 'class': ctx._tmp.class, 'command': ctx._tmp.command, 'object_type': ctx._tmp.object_type, 'statement_id': ctx._tmp.stmt_id, 'substatement_id': ctx._tmp.substmt_id]; String st = ctx._tmp.statement; if (st.endsWith(',<not logged>')) { st = st.substring(0, st.length() - 13); } if (st.startsWith('"') && st.endsWith('"') && st.length() > 1) { st = st.substring(1, st.length() - 1).replace('""', '"'); } ctx.db.statement = st; String up = st.trim().toUpperCase(); if (up.startsWith('COPY') && up.contains(' TO ')) { ctx.event.action = 'export'; }
